lines.beaver_en: You recommended Kim Minjun, right? What's he like?
lines.en: He has great integrity and is very trustworthy.

lines.learner: 털털하고 명랑해서 팀 분위기가 늘 밝아요.
lines.en: He's easygoing and cheerful, so the team mood is always bright.
lines.roman: Teoltteolhago myeongnanghaeseo tim bunwigiga neul balgayo.

lines.beaver_en: Nice. Does he have any weaknesses?
lines.learner: 굳이 꼽자면 처음엔 수줍음이 좀 많아요.
lines.en: If I had to pick one, he's a bit shy at first.
lines.roman: Guji kkopjamyeon cheoeumen sujubeumi jom manayo.

lines.beaver_en: Is he on the timid side?
lines.en: He's not timid. He's just a little sensitive.

lines.beaver_en: Won't being sensitive make work hard?
lines.learner: 대신 감성이 풍부해서 고객 마음을 잘 읽어요.
lines.en: Instead, he's emotionally rich and reads customers well.
lines.roman: Daesin gamseongi pungbuhaeseo gogaek maeumeul jal ilgeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Does he have any other strengths?
lines.en: He's optimistic and generous toward others.

lines.beaver_en: He isn't arrogant or rude, is he?
lines.en: He's never arrogant or mean at all.

lines.beaver_en: How is he with juniors? Is he strict?
lines.en: He's strict about work but generous with praise.

lines.beaver_en: Is he by any chance a bit blunt?
lines.learner: 악의는 없고 늘 선의로 하는 말이에요.
lines.en: There's no malice; he always speaks with good will.
lines.roman: Aguineun eopgo neul seonuiro haneun marieyo.

lines.beaver_en: Great. Then I'll set up an interview.
lines.learner: 단, 처음엔 긴장할 테니 편하게 해 주세요.
lines.en: But he'll be nervous at first, so please put him at ease.
lines.roman: Dan, cheoeumen ginjanghal teni pyeonhage hae juseyo.
